## Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rms)
})

metabolome_path <- "data/heldout_metabolome.tsv"
covariate_path <- "data/heldout_covariates.tsv"
prs_path <- "data/heldout_prs.tsv"
exposure_path <- "data/heldout_exposures.tsv"
independent_exposure_path <- "results/02_independent_exposures/independent_exposures.tsv"
total_pxs_path <- "results/03_pxs/total_pxs_raw.tsv"
group_manifest_path <- "results/03_pxs/group_pxs_manifest.tsv"
result_dir <- "results/04_prediction_models"
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Sample alignment and fold assignment

The input tables contain held-out participants. The two field 1647 indicators
identify country of birth. A single region-stratified split is shared by all
metabolites and models.

```{r}
metabolome_dt <- fread(metabolome_path, check.names = FALSE)
covariate_dt <- fread(covariate_path, check.names = FALSE)
prs_dt <- fread(prs_path, check.names = FALSE)
exposure_dt <- fread(exposure_path, check.names = FALSE)
total_pxs_dt <- fread(total_pxs_path, check.names = FALSE)
mapping_dt <- fread(independent_exposure_path, check.names = FALSE)

input_tables <- list(metabolome_dt, covariate_dt, prs_dt, exposure_dt, total_pxs_dt)
ids <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(input_tables, function(x) as.character(x$IID)))
region_dt <- exposure_dt[match(ids, as.character(IID)), .(
  IID = as.character(IID),
  region = fifelse(get("1647_2") == 1, "Wales",
                   fifelse(get("1647_3") == 1, "Scotland", NA_character_))
)][!is.na(region)]

set.seed(20260919)
region_dt[, fold := sample(rep(1:5, length.out = .N)), by = region]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(region_dt$IID))
stopifnot(all(vapply(split(region_dt$fold, region_dt$region),
                    function(x) setequal(x, 1:5), logical(1))))
ids <- region_dt$IID
align_ids <- function(x) x[match(ids, as.character(x$IID))]
metabolome_dt <- align_ids(metabolome_dt)
covariate_dt <- align_ids(covariate_dt)
prs_dt <- align_ids(prs_dt)
total_pxs_dt <- align_ids(total_pxs_dt)
write_tsv(as_tibble(region_dt), file.path(result_dir, "fold_assignments.tsv"))

metabolites <- intersect(setdiff(names(total_pxs_dt), "IID"), names(metabolome_dt))
metabolites <- metabolites[
  paste0(metabolites, "_common_variant_PRS") %in% names(prs_dt) &
  paste0(metabolites, "_rare_variant_PRS") %in% names(prs_dt)
]

make_model_data <- function(metabolite, pxs_dt) {
  tibble(
    IID = ids, fold = region_dt$fold,
    Y = metabolome_dt[[metabolite]],
    Age = covariate_dt$Age, Sex = factor(covariate_dt$Sex),
    PRS_common = prs_dt[[paste0(metabolite, "_common_variant_PRS")]],
    PRS_rare = prs_dt[[paste0(metabolite, "_rare_variant_PRS")]],
    PXS_raw = pxs_dt[[metabolite]]
  ) |> drop_na()
}
```

## Cross-validation

Within each metabolite and PXS score, all models use the same complete cases.
PXS scaling parameters and model coefficients are estimated only in the training
folds. Fold 0 denotes pooled out-of-fold performance, computed from all held-out
predictions rather than the mean of fold-specific R² values. Negative R² values
are retained.

```{r}
r_squared <- function(y, prediction) {
  sst <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  if (length(y) < 2L || !is.finite(sst) || sst == 0) return(NA_real_)
  1 - sum((y - prediction)^2) / sst
}

cross_validate <- function(model_df, model_spec, group_present = TRUE) {
  n <- nrow(model_df)
  predictions <- matrix(NA_real_, n, length(model_spec),
                        dimnames = list(NULL, names(model_spec)))
  fold_metrics <- vector("list", 5L)

  for (k in 1:5) {
    train <- model_df[model_df$fold != k, ]
    valid <- model_df[model_df$fold == k, ]
    status <- case_when(
      !group_present ~ "group_absent",
      n == 0L ~ "no_complete_cases",
      nrow(train) < 7L ~ "insufficient_training_n",
      nrow(valid) == 0L ~ "no_validation_cases",
      n_distinct(train$Sex) < 2L ~ "sex_single_level",
      TRUE ~ "ok"
    )
    pxs_mean <- mean(train$PXS_raw)
    pxs_sd <- sd(train$PXS_raw)
    train$PXS_z <- (train$PXS_raw - pxs_mean) / pxs_sd
    valid$PXS_z <- (valid$PXS_raw - pxs_mean) / pxs_sd

    fold_metrics[[k]] <- map_dfr(names(model_spec), function(model_name) {
      model_status <- status
      training_r2 <- validation_r2 <- NA_real_
      prediction <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(valid))
      if (model_status == "ok" && "PXS_z" %in% all.vars(model_spec[[model_name]]) &&
          (!is.finite(pxs_sd) || pxs_sd == 0)) {
        model_status <- "constant_training_pxs"
      }
      if (model_status == "ok") {
        fit <- lm(model_spec[[model_name]], data = train)
        if (anyNA(coef(fit))) {
          model_status <- "aliased_coefficient"
        } else {
          prediction <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = valid))
          training_r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
          validation_r2 <- r_squared(valid$Y, prediction)
        }
      }
      predictions[model_df$fold == k, model_name] <<- prediction
      tibble(
        model = model_name, fold = k, n_complete = n,
        n_train = nrow(train), n_valid = nrow(valid),
        n_oof = sum(is.finite(prediction)), train_r2 = training_r2,
        validation_r2 = validation_r2, status = model_status
      )
    })
  }
  fold_metrics <- bind_rows(fold_metrics)
  pooled <- map_dfr(names(model_spec), function(model_name) {
    prediction <- predictions[, model_name]
    statuses <- fold_metrics$status[fold_metrics$model == model_name]
    complete <- n > 0L && all(statuses == "ok") && all(is.finite(prediction))
    pooled_status <- if (complete) "pooled_ok" else if (n_distinct(statuses) == 1L) {
      statuses[1L]
    } else "incomplete_cv"
    tibble(
      model = model_name, fold = 0L, n_complete = n,
      n_train = NA_integer_, n_valid = NA_integer_,
      n_oof = sum(is.finite(prediction)), train_r2 = NA_real_,
      validation_r2 = if (complete) r_squared(model_df$Y, prediction) else NA_real_,
      status = pooled_status
    )
  })
  bind_rows(fold_metrics, pooled)
}
```

## Five prediction models

```{r}
model_spec <- list(
  Model0 = Y ~ Age + Sex,
  Model0b = Y ~ Age + Sex + PXS_z,
  Model1 = Y ~ Age + Sex + PRS_common,
  Model2 = Y ~ Age + Sex + PRS_common + PRS_rare,
  Model3 = Y ~ Age + Sex + PRS_common + PRS_rare + PXS_z
)

model_results <- map_dfr(metabolites, function(metabolite) {
  cross_validate(make_model_data(metabolite, total_pxs_dt), model_spec) |>
    mutate(metabolite = metabolite)
})

contributions <- model_results |>
  filter(fold == 0L) |>
  select(metabolite, n_complete, model, validation_r2) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = validation_r2) |>
  mutate(
    common_prs = Model1 - Model0,
    rare_prs = Model2 - Model1,
    PXS_vs_base = Model0b - Model0,
    PRS_vs_base = Model2 - Model0,
    PXS_given_PRS = Model3 - Model2,
    PRS_given_PXS = Model3 - Model0b,
    genetic_total = Model2 - Model0,
    joint_vs_base = Model3 - Model0
  )

write_tsv(model_results, file.path(result_dir, "cv_model_metrics.tsv"))
write_tsv(contributions, file.path(result_dir, "cv_prs_pxs_contributions.tsv"))
```

## Exposure-group models

```{r}
group_spec <- list(
  base = Y ~ Age + Sex,
  group_PXS = Y ~ Age + Sex + PXS_z,
  genetic = Y ~ Age + Sex + PRS_common + PRS_rare,
  genetic_group_PXS = Y ~ Age + Sex + PRS_common + PRS_rare + PXS_z
)
group_manifest <- read_tsv(group_manifest_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

group_model_results <- pmap_dfr(group_manifest, function(group, group_key, path) {
  group_pxs_dt <- align_ids(fread(path, check.names = FALSE))
  map_dfr(metabolites, function(metabolite) {
    present <- any(mapping_dt$Metabolite == metabolite & mapping_dt$Category == group)
    cross_validate(make_model_data(metabolite, group_pxs_dt), group_spec, present) |>
      mutate(metabolite = metabolite, group = group)
  })
})

group_contributions <- group_model_results |>
  filter(fold == 0L) |>
  select(metabolite, group, n_complete, model, validation_r2) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = validation_r2) |>
  mutate(
    group_pxs_vs_base = group_PXS - base,
    group_pxs_given_prs = genetic_group_PXS - genetic
  )

write_tsv(group_model_results, file.path(result_dir, "cv_group_model_metrics.tsv"))
write_tsv(group_contributions, file.path(result_dir, "cv_group_contributions.tsv"))
```

## Wald chi-square relative importance

```{r}
extract_total <- function(anova_table) {
  tibble(
    chisq = unname(anova_table["TOTAL", "Chi-Square"]),
    df = unname(anova_table["TOTAL", "d.f."]),
    p = unname(anova_table["TOTAL", "P"])
  )
}

wald_results <- map_dfr(metabolites, function(metabolite) {
  model_df <- make_model_data(metabolite, total_pxs_dt)
  if (nrow(model_df) < 7L || n_distinct(model_df$Sex) < 2L ||
      !is.finite(sd(model_df$PXS_raw)) || sd(model_df$PXS_raw) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      metabolite = metabolite,
      category = c("age_sex", "prs_common_rare", "total_pxs_z"),
      n = nrow(model_df), chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_integer_, p = NA_real_,
      total_model_chisq = NA_real_, relative_importance = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  model_df$total_PXS_z <- as.numeric(scale(model_df$PXS_raw))

  model_fit <- rms::ols(
    Y ~ Age + Sex + PRS_common + PRS_rare + total_PXS_z,
    data = model_df,
    x = TRUE,
    y = TRUE
  )
  total_chisq <- unname(anova(model_fit, test = "Chisq", ss = FALSE)["TOTAL", "Chi-Square"])

  bind_rows(
    extract_total(anova(model_fit, Age, Sex, test = "Chisq", ss = FALSE)) |>
      mutate(category = "age_sex"),
    extract_total(anova(model_fit, PRS_common, PRS_rare, test = "Chisq", ss = FALSE)) |>
      mutate(category = "prs_common_rare"),
    extract_total(anova(model_fit, total_PXS_z, test = "Chisq", ss = FALSE)) |>
      mutate(category = "total_pxs_z")
  ) |>
    mutate(
      metabolite = metabolite,
      n = nobs(model_fit),
      total_model_chisq = total_chisq,
      relative_importance = chisq / total_chisq
    )
})

readr::write_tsv(
  wald_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "wald_relative_importance.tsv")
)
```
